stages.name: Trade liberalisation: two disadvantages
stages.title: Trade liberalisation: two disadvantages
stages.sub: After this the student can explain how removing trade barriers can raise unemployment and worsen the current account.

steps.q: A country removes tariffs on imported steel. Its own steel mills have always relied on the tariff to compete with cheaper foreign steel. Once the tariff goes, can these mills sell at the same price as imports?
steps.right: No, their steel is now more expensive than imports
steps.wrong: Yes, price was never really the issue
steps.hint: The tariff was propping up the price of imported steel. Take it away and compare prices.

steps.q: Those steel mills start losing customers to cheaper imports and can no longer cover their costs. What happens to the workers there?
steps.right: Many are made redundant and struggle to find similar work
steps.wrong: They simply move to better-paid jobs at the same mill
steps.hint: If the mills are shrinking or closing, what happens to the people who worked in that specific industry?
